title: Finite-free basis inclusions and normalized scalar-Hom transpose
statement: For a finite-free coefficient extension S over R and the actual universal derived scalar pair T with normalized tensor models, obtain ordinary and derived extension/restriction adjunctions with the actual scalar-unit section formula and the chain-transpose normalization on flat-term K-flat representatives. For H = RHom_R(P,Q), the basis isomorphisms a_H : H^d ≅ U T H and a_Q : Q^d ≅ U T Q are pinned as follows: on every K-flat representative F and every isomorphism q : Q(F) ≅ X, their j-th components, transported via q and the specified counit, equal the localization of the chain map whose degreewise formula is x ↦ ringedFiniteFreeScalarSection(e.inv(e_j), x). The scalar-Hom isomorphism β : U RHom_S(TP,TQ) ≅ RHom_R(P,U T Q) is pinned by requiring its R tensor-Hom transpose to equal restricted S-evaluation after the normalized scalar unit and the lax restriction tensor map, the counit mate of the supplied strong tensor comparison. If c is the specified extended-evaluation transpose, then ι_i followed by a_H, U(c), and β equals RHom_R(P, ι_i followed by a_Q). Thus neither the basis maps nor β may be chosen using invertibility of c. Product preservation, matrix inversion, conservativity and naturality of c remain in [lem-sf-ringed-finite-free-hom-transpose].

source.place: Tag 08J9, label lemma-internal-hom: derived tensor-Hom adjunction. The finite-free change-of-rings specialization and its evaluation normalization are the auxiliary assertion here, not a verbatim assertion of that tag.

proof.text: Choose an $R$-linear isomorphism $S\cong R^{\oplus d}$ and write $e_j:R\to S$ for its basis inclusions. Let $U$ denote restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. For every $X\in D(R)$ there is a natural isomorphism $a_X:X^{\oplus d}\xrightarrow{\sim}UTX$, with components $b_j^X=1_X\otimes e_j$. Indeed, choose a K-flat resolution $F\to X$ [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] and compute $TX$ by $F\otimes_R S$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The tensor definition [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] gives the degreewise mutually inverse maps $F^{\oplus d}\to U(F\otimes_R S)$, $(x_j)\mapsto\sum_j x_j\otimes e_j$, and $x\otimes\sum_j r_je_j\mapsto(r_jx)_j$; they commute with differentials. Finite sums of the resolution remain quasi-isomorphisms, since kernels and images of a finite block-diagonal differential are the corresponding finite sums. Thus these maps give $a_X$ after localization. This also proves naturality in $X$. The Lean predicate RingedFiniteFreeBasisCoordinates records this component formula on every K-flat F and every q : Q(F) ≅ X: the chain map b_j has degreewise section x ↦ ringedFiniteFreeScalarSection J φ E h (F.X n) V (e.inv(e_j)(1)) x, and its derived class, with restriction comparison and q transport, equals ι_j followed by a_X and the specified universal counit. This normalization determines a_X, including for rank zero.

source.place: Tag 08J9, label lemma-internal-hom, and Tag 08JA, label lemma-section-RHom-over-U; agent finite-free specialization using the adjunction counit and finite biproducts.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-dc-hom-scalar-adjunction] with $K=P$ and $N=TQ$. It gives an isomorphism $\beta:UH_S(TP,TQ)\xrightarrow{\sim}H_R(P,UTQ)$. Its normalization says explicitly that the transpose of $\beta$ is restricted $S$-linear evaluation after inserting the scalar-extension unit $\eta_P:P\to UTP$. The same node states that $U$ reflects isomorphisms. All its hypotheses hold: the site is small and $P,Q$ are arbitrary objects of the ordinary unbounded module-sheaf derived categories. No condensed-coefficient or constructibility hypothesis is used. Transport the canonical ordinary and derived scalar adjunctions to the supplied E and T by their object/map formulas and the universal counit comparison. Retain the ordinary 1 tensor x unit formula and the chain-transpose normalization. The β clause is explicitly its tensor-Hom transpose equation: tensor(1, eta_P), then eta on the tensor, then U(mu followed by tensor(epsilon,epsilon)), then U(evaluation). This is the expansion of scalarHomRestrictedEvaluation for the transported models. Transposition is bijective, so it pins β without assuming c invertible.

source.place: Tag 08J9, label lemma-internal-hom, and Tag 08JA, label lemma-section-RHom-over-U; agent finite-free specialization using the adjunction counit and finite biproducts.

proof.text: Let c be the specified extended-evaluation transpose. Transpose β after U(c) and the i-th basis inclusion into U T H. The normalized scalar unit inserts 1_S and the κ generator formula, together with the μ localization square, multiplies this by e_i. The resulting map is R-evaluation followed by the i-th basis inclusion into U T Q. By uniqueness of tensor-Hom transpose this equals RHom_R(P,ι_i followed by a_Q). The calculation uses only the bilinear tensor relations on the actual K-flat representatives and localization. For d=0 there are no inclusions. No product preservation or matrix inversion is used.

theorem ringedFiniteFreeHomBaseChange_coordinates
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S))]
    (d : ℕ) (e :
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).map φ)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit
            (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S)) ≅
        SheafOfModules.free (R :=
          SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)
            (ULift.{max c v r} (Fin d)))
    (E : SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S))
      (h : ∀ M, E.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings φ M)
      (_hm : ∀ {M N : SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)} (f : M ⟶ N),
        E.map f = eqToHom (h M) ≫ SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom φ M f ≫
          eqToHom (h N).symm)
      [_hE : E.Additive]
      (T : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
          (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S)))
      (ε : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ T ⟶
        E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
      (_hT : T.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
        (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
      (AR : WeilConjectures.CoefficientClosedStructure
        (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R))
      (AS : WeilConjectures.CoefficientClosedStructure
        (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J S))
      (MR : WeilConjectures.CoefficientTensorModels.{r, c, v, w} J R AR)
      (MS : WeilConjectures.CoefficientTensorModels.{r, c, v, w} J S AS)
      (κ : WeilConjectures.coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R ⋙
          E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ≅
        (E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).prod
          (E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙
            WeilConjectures.coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J S)
      (μ : AR.tensor ⋙ T ≅ T.prod T ⋙ AS.tensor)
    (hκ : (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ℤ)
        (p q : ℤ) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U),
        ((κ.hom.app (P, Q)).f (p + q)).val.app U
          (ringedFiniteFreeScalarSection.{c, v, r} J φ E h
            (((WeilConjectures.coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj (P, Q)).X (p + q))
            U 1 (WeilConjectures.coefficientTensorGenerator.{r, c, v} J R
              P Q p q (p + q) rfl U x y)) =
        WeilConjectures.coefficientTensorGenerator.{r, c, v} J S
          ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
          ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q (p + q) rfl U
          (ringedFiniteFreeScalarSection.{c, v, r} J φ E h (P.X p) U 1 x)
          (ringedFiniteFreeScalarSection.{c, v, r} J φ E h (Q.X q) U 1 y)))
    (hcomp : (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ℤ)
        (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) P)
        (hQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) Q),
        ∃ (hEP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := S)
            ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P))
          (hEQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := S)
            ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q)),
          IsIso (ε.app P) ∧ IsIso (ε.app Q) ∧
          T.map ((MR.iso J R AR P Q hP hQ).hom) ≫
              μ.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫
              AS.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (ε.app P) (ε.app Q)) =
            ε.app ((WeilConjectures.coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj (P, Q)) ≫
              DerivedCategory.Q.map (κ.hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
              (MS.iso J S AS _ _ hEP hEQ).hom)) :
    ∃ (adj : E ⊣ SheafOfModules.scalarRestriction φ)
      (δ : T ⊣ SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction φ),
      (∀ (M : SheafOfModules.scalarModules J R) (V : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj V),
        (adj.unit.app M).val.app V x = ringedFiniteFreeScalarSection.{c, v, r} J φ E h M V 1 x) ∧
      (∀ (F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.scalarModules J R) ℤ),
        CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) F →
        (∀ n : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := J) (R := R) (F.X n)) →
        ∀ (N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.scalarModules J S) ℤ)
          (g : F ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.scalarRestriction φ).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj N),
        (δ.homEquiv (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)).symm
            (DerivedCategory.Q.map g ≫
              (SheafOfModules.scalarRestrictionComparison φ).inv.app N) =
          ε.app F ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
            (SheafOfModules.scalarChainTranspose.{c, v, max c v r} φ E _hE adj F N g)) ∧
    ∀ P Q : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)),
    ∃ (a : (⨁ fun _ : Fin d ↦
        (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj (op P, Q)) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction φ).obj
        (T.obj ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj (op P, Q))))
      (aQ : (⨁ fun _ : Fin d ↦ Q) ≅
        (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction φ).obj (T.obj Q))
      (β : (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction φ).obj
        ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J S).obj (op (T.obj P), T.obj Q)) ≅
        (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj
          (op P, (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction φ).obj (T.obj Q))),
      RingedFiniteFreeBasisCoordinates.{c, v, r, w} J φ d e E h T ε
        ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj (op P, Q)) a ∧
      RingedFiniteFreeBasisCoordinates.{c, v, r, w} J φ d e E h T ε Q aQ ∧
      (AR.transpose _ P ((SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction φ).obj (T.obj Q))).symm
          β.hom =
        AR.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) (δ.unit.app P)) ≫
          δ.unit.app _ ≫
          (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction φ).map
            (μ.hom.app _ ≫ AS.tensor.map
              (Prod.mkHom (δ.counit.app _) (δ.counit.app _))) ≫
          (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction φ).map
            (AS.evaluation (T.obj P) (T.obj Q)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin d,
        biproduct.ι _ i ≫ a.hom ≫
          (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction φ).map
            (AS.transpose _ (T.obj P) (T.obj Q)
              (μ.inv.app
                ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj (op P, Q), P) ≫
                T.map (AR.evaluation P Q))) ≫ β.hom =
          (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).map
            (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (op P)) (biproduct.ι _ i ≫ aQ.hom))
